verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only privacy-adjacent statement is that the six bundled Python helper scripts do not touch the network, which covers those scripts only and is not a documented opt-out for the skill as a whole. missing for 10: a documented telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out mechanism, an explicit statement of what (if anything) is collected, and coverage beyond the helper scripts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
